title: Opportunity
description: One job opportunity as exchanged between the search agent and the dashboard. See CONTRACT.md for field ownership and the merge policy.
$comment: This schema is the agent's obligation: emit all of these. The dashboard is deliberately more tolerant than the schema, and rejects a row only when title, company or score is unusable, coercing the rest with a reported warning. Losing a real opportunity to a missing enum would be worse than showing it with a default. `band` is not required because the dashboard always derives it from `score`.

id.description: Stable hash of the dedup key. Owned by the dashboard; the agent may omit it.

company.description: The employer, not the job board.

source.description: Where the posting was found. Free-form so a new adapter does not require a schema change.

url.description: Canonical posting URL. Primary input to the dedup key.

apply_url.description: Direct application link, or empty when there is no separate one. Anchored at both ends on purpose: an unanchored optional prefix matches every string, which is not validation.

posted.description: YYYY-MM-DD, or empty when the posting does not say.

band.description: Derived by the dashboard from score: strong >= 90, possible 70 to 89, weak < 70. If the agent emits a band that disagrees with the score, the score wins and the disagreement is reported.

rationale.description: One sentence on why it could fit.

status.description: Human-owned. Never overwritten by an import.
